title: Fix Output showing multiple selections with collapse duplicates on

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #123222
- Closes #111664
- Supersedes #111676

## Additional information

From the investigation, I found the multiple selection in Output panel is a drawing issue (extra highlights) caused by some stale values rather than selection itself. The reasons are: (1) Selection values are correct, and copying the selection worked as expected (it only copies the actually selected part). (2) After any changes triggering `EditorLog::_rebuild_log()` (such as changing a log filter, using the search box, etc.), the selection comes back to the expected behavior. (3) It happens when printing the same text at least twice at once. 

For the background, `RichTextLabel::_process_line_caches()` is executed lazily after log lines are added, and it uses `total_chars` from `first_invalid_line`'s `char_offset`. The `first_invalid_line` is usually already shaped at this point, but after `remove_paragraph()` for Collapse duplicate, a blank (unshaped) trailing paragraph becomes the `first_invalid_line`. Since it has only default init values, the `char_offset` value of the `first_invalid_line` in the `_process_line_caches()` is now 0, which is used to shape the line. This makes `_draw_line` draw the extra highlights since it uses those offsets to compute the position, and several lines end up with the same offset values.

This fix makes `_process_line_caches()` use a valid `total_chars` value from the previous line (which is a valid line, already shaped), not the one from the invalid line. This doesn't change other cases because if the first invalid line was correctly shaped, its `char_offset` is already the same as the one calculated with the previous line.

_* Claude Opus 5 and 5.5 were used to learn LLDB commands and advanced debugger features._
